exposure: Type of Cesarean Section (standard vs. gentle)
outcome: Preference for vaginal delivery in future pregnancies
cohort: The study included 21 couples with low-risk pregnancies scheduled for elective cesarean delivery at term, with 15 couples undergoing a standard cesarean and 6 undergoing a gentle section.
finding: Overall parental satisfaction with cesarean section was high, but there is room for improvement, with women in the standard group feeling less involved and participants in the gentle section group showing less fear of childbirth after delivery.
mod_finding: Women undergoing a standard cesarean section felt less involved in childbirth compared to those undergoing a gentle section, and participants in the gentle section group showed less fear of childbirth after delivery than prior to delivery.
